name: HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee)
summary: Approved human gene symbols and names, with aliases, previous symbols and cross-references (Ensembl, Entrez, UniProt, OMIM), plus VGNC symbols for other vertebrates.
notes: Keyless. The Accept header picks the format: application/json is sent here; without it the service answers XML.
At most 10 requests per second; heavier clients get 403 and may have their IP blocked.
search returns only hgnc_id, symbol and score per hit; follow up with fetch for the full record.
Search terms take * and ? wildcards and AND/OR/NOT between field:term pairs (e.g. symbol:ZNF* AND status:Approved). fetch takes no wildcards and one term.
Prefix a path with /vgnc (e.g. /vgnc/search/symbol/BRCA2) for non-human vertebrate genes; not modelled as separate endpoints here.

endpoints.name: Get service info and fields
endpoints.summary: Last update time, record count, and the searchable and stored fields.

endpoints.name: Search genes by a field
endpoints.summary: Genes whose field matches a term, with hgnc_id, symbol and score.

field.description: A searchable field, e.g. symbol, alias_symbol, prev_symbol, name, entrez_id, ensembl_gene_id, uniprot_ids, location, status.

term.description: Search term; * and ? wildcards allowed; phrases in URL-encoded double quotes.

endpoints.name: Search genes across all fields
endpoints.summary: Genes matching a term in any searchable field, or a boolean field:term query.

query.description: A term, or field:term pairs joined by AND, OR, NOT.

endpoints.name: Fetch full gene records
endpoints.summary: Every stored field (names, aliases, locus, gene groups, cross-references) of the genes matching one exact value.

field.description: A searchable field, e.g. symbol, hgnc_id, entrez_id, ensembl_gene_id, prev_symbol, alias_symbol.
